newsitem.title: USA: SoCal Edison nuclear unit start delayed.
newsitem.headline: SoCal Edison nuclear unit start delayed.

text.p: Edison International's Southern California Edison Co will not restart the 1,080 megawatt unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear plant until the end of next week, a company spokesman said Thursday.
The unit has been down since the beginning of last week for repairs to a leak in the reactor's coolant system. It had been expected to restart by Monday.
The San Onofre plant's 1,070 MW unit 3 is scheduled to shut for a 70-day refueling on November 30.
Edison has a 75 percent stake in the San Onofre plant, while San Diego Gas and Electric Co owns 20 percent and municipal utilities share the remaining five percent.
